summary: The majority of the reviewed candidates exhibit dual roles as confounders and effect modifiers, characterized by strong signals in predictive forests for treatment/outcome and causal forests for effect modification. Gender identity and fatigue show particularly robust evidence across all roles. Family history markers and lesion presence show a strong leaning toward effect modification and outcome prognosis. Gemcitabine tolerance is the only candidate with insufficient evidence to justify a role.
